contract:
Contract CoCoMESystem::receiveOrderedProduct(orderID: Integer): Boolean {
	definition:
		orderProduct: OrderProduct = OrderProduct.allInstances()->any(op: OrderProduct|op.Id = orderID)
	precondition:
		OrderProduct.allInstances()->one(op: OrderProduct|op.Id = orderID)
	postcondition:
		result = true and
		orderProduct.OrderStatus = OrderStatus::RECEIVED and
		Item.allInstances()->forAll(i: Item|if orderProduct.ContainedEntries@pre->exists(e: OrderEntry|e.Item@pre = i) 
		then i.StockNumber = i.StockNumber@pre+orderProduct.ContainedEntries@pre->sumBy(e: OrderEntry|if e.Item@pre = i 
		then e.Quantity@pre 
		else 0 
		endif ) 
		else true 
		endif )
}
